title: Appendix containing Canons and Rulings not having Conciliar Origin but Approved by Name in Canon II. of the Synod in Trullo: The Narrative of the Same concerning Those Called Cathari

verses.text:
The Narrative of
the Same concerning Those Called Cathari.

Because the great synod held at Nice has decreed, That
[the clergymen] who come over to the Church from the Novatians be
ordained; do you ordain those that come over, if their life be upright,
and there be no objection.
